answer: Proof-of-burn entry gating resists sybil attacks by making every new agent identity irreversibly destroy a fixed quantity of copper-backed tokens before it can join the market. The burn is public and unrecoverable, so one honest agent pays once, but an attacker spinning up a fleet pays that toll per fake identity. To flood a vote or a trade route like a cheap zephyr, the attacker must fund thousands of burns, turning a quick voyage into a capital-heavy loss that scales linearly with the forgery count.
